For years, providing these essential services was a challenge due to infrastructure limitations. Relying on on-premises data centers meant that power outages or internet disruptions could interrupt necessary warnings at pivotal moments. Seeking better reliability, ICPAC began a transition to ICPAC in 2017. However, the need to get services online quickly led to a monolithic architecture where overprovisioned virtual machines weren’t as cost-effective or as fast as they could be. To ensure its infrastructure could fully support its regional mission, ICPAC worked with Google Cloud partner “Technology’s the foundation of our work in enhancing resilience for the region, and we needed to ensure we were using it effectively,” explains Leonard M.
